📺 Tacoma FD (2019–2023)

Tacoma FD follows a group of eccentric firefighters working at a fire station in Tacoma, Washington, one of America’s rainiest cities. With relatively few fires to extinguish, the firefighters spend much of their time entertaining themselves through ridiculous competitions, elaborate pranks, and hilarious workplace adventures. Led by Chief Terry McConky and Captain Eddie Penisi, the team constantly finds creative ways to overcome boredom while responding to unusual emergency calls and dealing with everyday responsibilities. Things become even more entertaining when Terry’s daughter, Lucy, joins the department and attempts to prove herself among her unconventional coworkers. Starring Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Hassie Harrison, and Marcus Henderson, the series delivers outrageous humor, memorable characters, and entertaining storytelling about friendship, teamwork, workplace rivalries, and the hilarious challenges of life inside a firehouse.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace Comedy • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 24 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Kevin Heffernan & Steve Lemme

📺 Seasons: 4 • 49 Episodes

📍 Setting: Tacoma, Washington.
